xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DeclarationOfUnmodifiedOpinio: Statement on impact of audit qualification
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1) The aforesaid consol financial results of IL&FS Investment Managers Ltd (Holding Company), its subsidiaries (Holding Company & its subsidiaries together constitute Group) & jointly controlled entities for quarter & year ended 31-03-2023 along-with comparative quarter & year have been reviewed by Audit Committee at its meeting held on 29-05-2023 & subsequently approved by BOD of the Company at its meeting held on 30-05-2023 in terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI LODR 2) The financial results have been prepared in accordance with Ind AS as per the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules 2015 notified under Sec 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 (CA 2013) & other relevant provisions of the CA 2013 as amended from time to time 3) As per requirements of Ind AS 108 on ‘Operating Segments’, based on evaluation of financial info for allocation of resources & assessing performance, the Group has identified a single segment i.e. providing asset management services & other related services. As such, there are no separate reportable business or geographical segments as per Ind AS 108 4) MCA, Government of India, has vide its letter dated 01-10-2018 initiated investigation by SFIO against IL&FS, the Holding Company & its subsidiaries (including the Group) under Sec 212(1) of CA 2013. On 03-12-2018, MCA on the directions of NCLT, Mumbai has impleaded various Group Companies of IL&FS (which includes the Group) as Respondents to the Petition filed by them on 01-10-2018. Further based on another petition of the MCA under Sec 130 (1) of CA 2013, NCLT has, on 01-01-2019, ordered re-opening of books of a/cs for past FY 2012-13 to FY 2017-18 of IL&FS (Ultimate Holding Company), IL&FS Financial Services Ltd & IL&FS Transportation Networks Ltd (fellow subsidiaries). While the Group, based on its current understanding, believes that the above would not have a material impact on financial results, the implications, if any, arising from the aforesaid developments would be known only after the aforesaid matters are concluded & hence are not determinable at this stage 5) The term of most of the existing funds being managed/advised by Holding Company & few of its subsidiaries has already been over. Other funds being managed/advised by Holding Company & few of its subsidiaries Group are approaching end of their term in near future which has resulted in significant reduction in such entities fee revenue. Mngmt expects that its future income from existing funds being managed/advised together with liquid assets held by Group as at 31-03-2023 will be adequately sufficient to meet the Group's existing and future obligations arising over next 12 months. Mngmt believes that use of the going concern assumption for preparation of these financial results is appropriate 6) The BODs of the Company at its meeting held on 14-02-2022 approved a Scheme of Amalgamation (SOA) of its two WOS IL&FS Asian Infrastructure Managers Ltd & IIML Asset Advisors Ltd with the Company, subject to approval of shareholders and/or creditors of respective companies and necessary regulatory approvals. The Appointed Date for the said SOA is scheduled to be 01-04-2022 7) The financial statements of its subsidiary IIML Fund Managers (Singapore) Pte Ltd & its Joint Ventures IL&FS Milestone Realty Advisors Private Ltd & Standard Chartered IL&FS Management (Singapore) Pte Ltd have been prepared on the basis that it does not continue as a going concern 8) The figures for 3 months ended 31-03-2023 & 31-03-2022 are the balancing figures between the audited figures with respect to full FY & the published unaudited year to date figures upto the 3rd quarter of the FY which were subject to limited review 9) The BODs, in their meeting held on 30-05-2023 have proposed a final dividend of Rs 0.80 per equity share amounting to Rs 2,512.26 lakhs. The proposal is subject to the approval of shareholders at the AGM 10) Previous year numbers are regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary
